content.hebrew: אָכֵן אֵין כֵּאלֹהֵֽינו, וְאֵין צוּר כַּאדֹנֵֽינוּ,
content.transliteration: Akhen en kelohenu, ve’en tsur kadonenu,
content.english: Indeed, none is like our God and no rock like our Lord,

content.hebrew: הַמְעַטְּרֵֽנוּ חֶֽסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, וְהֵאִיר עֵינֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Ham‘atterenu ḥesed veraḥamim, vehe’ir ‘enenu.
content.english: Who has crowned us with mercy and compassion, and has given light to our eyes.

content.hebrew: רָדִֽינוּ בְיַעְרַת דָּתוֹ; דְּבַשׁ וְחָלָב תַּֽחַת לְשׁוֹנֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Radinu veya‘rat dato; devash veḥalav taḥat leshonenu.
content.english: We have taken of the honeycomb of His law; honey and milk are under our tongue.

content.hebrew: נְתִיב יֹֽשֶׁר הוֹרָֽנוּ, וְשִׁנֵּס מָתְנֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Netiv yosher horanu, veshinnes motnenu.
content.english: He has shown us the way of uprightness, and girded our loins.

content.hebrew: בִּנְאוֹת שֵֽׂכֶל הִרְבִּיצָֽנוּ, וּבְצֵל חָכְמָה שָׂם מְלוֹנֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Bin’ot sekhel hirbitsanu, uvtsel ḥokhma sam melonenu.
content.english: He has laid us down in the dwellings of understanding, and he has placed our lodging in the shadow of wisdom.

content.hebrew: חָסְנֵֽנוּ הִרְבָּה, וְקִדֵּשׁ קְדֻשָּׁה יְתֵרָה לְכֹהֲנֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Ḥosnenu hirba, veḳiddesh ḳedush’sha yetera lekhohanenu,
content.english: He has increased our strength, and sanctified our priests with especial sanctity;

content.hebrew: וּכְבוֹד יוי הָיָה מְאוֹרָם, לִרְעוֹת עֶדְרֵי הֲמוֹנֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Ukhvod Adonai haya me’oram, lir‘ot ‘edrē hamonenu,
content.english: Adonai’s Glory has been their light, [by which] to shepherd our teeming flocks.

content.hebrew: הֵם הָיוּ מְשָׁרְתֵי יוי, לְהָפִיק רְצוֹנֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Hem hayu mesharetē Adonai, lehafiḳ retsonenu.
content.english: They were the ones serving Adonai, to carry out our will.

content.hebrew: לֹא יִגְּעוּ לְנֶֽפֶשׁ מֵת לְבֵינֵֽנוּ,
content.transliteration: Lo yigge‘u lenefesh met levenenu
content.english: They may not touch any person that is dead, among us,

content.hebrew: כִּי אִם לִשְׁאֵרָם הַקָּרוֹב אֲלֵיהֶם, לְעֵינֵֽינוּ,
content.transliteration: ki im liseram haḳarov alehem, le‘enenu,
content.english: Other than their relatives, who are close to them, as we see,

content.hebrew: וְזוֹנָה וַחֲלָלָה וּגְרוּשָׁה – לְבַל יִקְחוּ בְּפָנֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Vezona vaḥalala uḡrusha – leval yiḳḥu befanenu.
content.english: And they may not take [as wives] a zona, ḥalala, or divorcée, in our presence.
content.comments: Zona, ḥalala. Women who are not allowed to marry priests due to certain sexual improprieties, whether in the own pasts or their parents’.

content.hebrew: וְנִמְשָׁח בָּרֹאשׁ, מְכַפֵּר זְדוֹנֵֽינוּ,
content.transliteration: Venimshaḥ barosh mekhapper zedonenu,
content.english: The one whose head is anointed, who atones for our wanton sins,

content.hebrew: לְכָל־מֵת לֹא יָבוֹא, וּבְתוּלָה יִקַּח מִבֵּינֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Lekhol met lo yavo uvtula yiḳḳaḥ mibbenenu.
content.english: May not encounter any corpse, and must take [as a wife] a virgin from among us.

content.hebrew: יִהְיוּ בְלִי מוּם, וְכֵן יִהְיוּ קָרְבָּנֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Yihyu veli mum, vekhen ḳorbanenu.
content.english: [The priests] must be without blemish, and so must our sacrifices.

content.hebrew: עָלְתָה מַעֲלָתָם כְּמוֹ כּוֹכְבֵי מְעוֹנֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: ‘aleta ma‘alatam kemo kokhevē me‘onenu.
content.english: Their level is lofty, like the stars of our sky.

content.hebrew: יִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְרוֹמַם אֲשֶׁר תּוֹרָתוֹ חֲנָנָֽנוּ,
content.transliteration: Yit‘allē vitromam asher torato ḥanananu,
content.english: May [God] be lofty and elevated, He who has graced us with His Torah,

content.hebrew: וּמוֹעֲדֵי שִׂמְחָה וּמִקְרָאֵי קֹֽדֶשׁ נָתַן לָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Umo‘adē simḥa umiḳra’ē ḳodesh natan lanu.
content.english: And has given us festivals of joy and sanctified convocations.

content.hebrew: לְדֹר וָדֹר נַגִּיד גָּדְלוֹ בְּפִֽינוּ, אָב לְבָנֵֽינוּ,
content.transliteration: Ledor vador naggid godlo befinu, av levanenu,
content.english: From generation to generation shall we tell of His greatness, with our mouths, fathers to children,

content.hebrew: קהל: נוֹדֶה לְמַלְכֵּֽנוּ נוֹדֶה לְמוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ – כִּי מִי כְקוֹנֵֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Nodē lemalkenu nodē lemoshi‘enu – ki mi kheḳonenu?
content.english: Cong. We give acknowledgement to our king, we give acknowledgement to our rescuer—for who is like our maker?

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּ֥י מִי־אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְֽעֲדֵ֣י יו֑י וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִבַּלְֽעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל ב ככ:לב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki mi el mibbal‘adē Adonai umi tsur mibbal‘adē elohenu:
content.english: Cantor. For who is God besides Adonai, and who is a rock besides our God? (2 Sam. 22:32)

content.hebrew: [אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיוי כִּי־אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּֽאלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל א ב:ב)]
content.transliteration: En Ḳadosh ka’Adonai ki en biltekha ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none besides You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל:  (תהלים כב:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. And You are holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
